changes.description: Integrate the existing Leptos-derived core source into blog maintenance. Rename the package/library, local dependency paths and generated macro references from xcss_web to blog_ui. Preserve all original MIT copyright and license bytes. Original per-file source receipt is archived unchanged.

Specialize the runtime for the actual browser CSR consumers. Remove unreachable SSR/hydration/island/lazy modules and their dependency edges. Retain component props, children, keyed/context ownership, mount/unmount cleanup and portal including the use_shadow failure guard. Replace AnimatedShow RSX with equivalent element/props builders. Keep the application font/startup-failure contracts unchanged.

Integrate retained CSR implementation modules and compiler helpers as recorded in INTEGRATED-SOURCES.json. Preserve earlier provenance and original licenses. Component names use an independently implemented Unicode-aware conversion; discarded implementations are explicitly retired in the append-only migration ledger.
